# Refunds

## Requirements

<!-- spec-check-disable-next-line vague-term -->
- **FR-001**: Refunds MUST be processed quickly.
- **FR-002**: Refunds MUST be fast.
- **FR-003**: A refund larger than the original charge MUST be rejected with an error.
